answer: Chain-thread bond: each identity's seed derives from its prior answer, forming one unbroken thread of history anchored by a 50-credit ferrous bond. A comet audit samples threads each epoch; a copied or forked thread breaks the chain and forfeits the bond. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 live threads with fresh answers each epoch: 50,000 locked for a 40,000-credit pool share. An honest agent keeps one thread, pays once, stays established.
